agent_pin.permission_bypass_disclosure: Harbor 0.25.0's stock OpenCode agent launch command includes --dangerously-skip-permissions (harbor/agents/installed/opencode.py run()); it cannot be disabled through stock task config. The baked opencode 1.19.4 binary accepts the flag (CLI options --auto/--yolo/--dangerously-skip-permissions, hidden). Container-level containment is therefore the enforced boundary: agent UID 1001 cannot write the trusted verifier/records; no host secrets are forwarded into trial containers on this pilot.

trusted_startup_fix.blocker: the image ENV is HOME=/workspace (agent-writable) and the verifier's wrapper subprocesses use fixture/mock-home as HOME, so an agent-planted usercustomize/sitecustomize module under either .local/lib/pythonX.Y/site-packages tree could execute inside a trusted Python whose user site is enabled (demonstrated in-image: /usr/bin/python3.12 as root with PYTHONUSERBASE=/workspace/<agent tree> imported the planted usercustomize and wrote marker files)
trusted_startup_fix.fix: package-level only (image, vendored wrapper/lib and verifier bytes unchanged): tests/test.sh now (1) resets the environment BEFORE any Python — PATH pinned to the trusted fixed image paths with /opt/app-root/bin FIRST (the UBI scl Python 3.12 carrying the image's PyYAML; never /usr/bin/python3.9), PYTHONPATH/PYTHONHOME/PYTHONUSERBASE unset, PYTHONNOUSERSITE=1, HOME=/root; (2) runs an isolated '/opt/app-root/bin/python3 -I' stdlib-only prelude that lstat-validates the fixture root and its repo/origin.git/mock-home components (links and non-directories refused, never followed), refuses anything not strictly inside /workspace, then replaces ONLY fixture/mock-home with a fresh empty real 0755 dir via rename+mkdir+trusted shutil.rmtree on the validated path (no shell rm -rf, no host paths); (3) on any prelude failure writes flat numeric reward 0 + reward.txt 0.0 + UNSCORABLE verdict.json sidecar and exits nonzero — the real verifier never starts; (4) only then runs the existing chown -R 0:0 ownership normalization and bash /opt/git-pilot/bin/verify.sh
trusted_startup_fix.prelude_imports: json, os, shutil, stat, sys, pathlib only; no agent code, no subprocess, no network
